definitions.gloss: to take lightly; to underestimate; to not take seriously
definitions.explanation: To fail to recognize the difficulty or seriousness of something, or to look down on someone's ability. A common idiomatic expression used as a warning or criticism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘|あま}く{見|み}て⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘|あま}く{見|み}て⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not underestimate the power of nature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘|あま}く{見|み}た⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Because I underestimated the opponent, I made a big mistake.

notes:
USAGE:
{甘|あま}く{見|み}る is an extremely common expression in everyday Japanese. It is often used in the negative imperative form {甘|あま}く{見|み}るな or {甘|あま}く{見|み}て⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない to warn someone not to be complacent. The past form {甘|あま}く{見|み}て⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧ implies regret for having been careless.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{甘|あま}く{見|み}る (to underestimate ~)
- {甘|あま}く{見|み}るな (don't underestimate)
- {甘|あま}く{見|み}て⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない (you must not take lightly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{侮|あなど}る→侮る：10884_anadoru⟧: to look down on, to scorn
- ⟦{軽|かろ}んじる→軽んじる：15622_karonjiru⟧: to make light of (formal)
- なめる: to look down on (very colloquial, rough)
